aws:cdk:cloudformation:props.definition:
type Product @aws_api_key @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  id: ID!
  name: String!
  description: String
  brand: String!
  category: String
  variants: [Variant!]!
  createdAt: String
  updatedAt: String
}

type Variant @aws_api_key @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  id: ID!
  sku: String!
  size: String
  color: String
  basePrice: Float!
  images: [String]
}

type Query {
  # Obtener un producto por ID. Usa Lambda resolver para inyectar precio VIP si el usuario está logueado.
  getProduct(id: ID!): Product @aws_api_key @aws_cognito_user_pools
  
  # Listar productos (con paginación simple y filtro)
  listProducts(brand: String, category: String, limit: Int, nextToken: String): ProductConnection! @aws_api_key @aws_cognito_user_pools

  # Perfil de usuario logueado
  getUserProfile: User @aws_cognito_user_pools
  
  # Listar pedidos del usuario logueado
  listUserOrders: [Order!]! @aws_cognito_user_pools
  
  # ADMINISTRADOR: Listar todos los pedidos con filtros
  listAllOrders(status: String, email: String, startDate: String, endDate: String, limit: Int, nextToken: String): OrderConnection! @aws_cognito_user_pools
  
  # ADMINISTRADOR: Listar usuarios
  listUsers(limit: Int, nextToken: String): UserConnection! @aws_cognito_user_pools
}

type ProductConnection @aws_api_key @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  items: [Product!]!
  nextToken: String
}

enum PaymentMethod {
  STANDARD
  DEFERRED
}

input CreateOrderInput {
  type: PaymentMethod!
  items: [OrderItemInput!]!
  totalAmount: Float!
  customerEmail: String
  customerName: String
  paymentMethod: String
  shippingAddress: AddressInput
  billingAddress: AddressInput
}

input OrderItemInput {
  productId: ID!
  variantId: ID!
  quantity: Int!
  priceAtPurchase: Float!
  name: String
  image: String
}

type OrderResponse @aws_api_key @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  orderId: ID!
  checkoutUrl: String
  status: String!
}

type Mutation {
  createOrder(input: CreateOrderInput!): OrderResponse @aws_api_key @aws_cognito_user_pools
  
  # Actualizar datos del perfil de usuario (envío/facturación)
  updateUserProfile(input: UpdateUserProfileInput!): User @aws_cognito_user_pools
  
  # ADMINISTRADOR: Asignar un precio especial a un usuario para un producto
  setSpecialPrice(userId: ID!, productId: ID!, specialPrice: Float!): UserPrice @aws_cognito_user_pools
  
  # ADMINISTRADOR: Habilitar o deshabilitar pago a 30 días
  setCanPayLater(userId: ID!, canPayLater: Boolean!): User @aws_cognito_user_pools
  
  # ADMINISTRADOR: Actualizar estado de un pedido
  updateOrderStatus(orderId: ID!, userId: String!, status: String!): Order @aws_cognito_user_pools
}

# --- NUEVOS MODELOS Y TIPOS ---

type User @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  id: ID!
  email: String!
  name: String
  role: String! # "USER" o "ADMIN"
  shippingAddress: Address
  billingAddress: Address
  specialPrices: [UserPrice]
  can_pay_later: Boolean
  cif: String
}

type UserConnection @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  items: [User!]!
  nextToken: String
}

type Address @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  name: String
  street: String
  city: String
  postalCode: String
  country: String
  cif: String
}

input UpdateUserProfileInput {
  name: String
  shippingAddress: AddressInput
  billingAddress: AddressInput
}

input AddressInput {
  name: String
  street: String
  city: String
  postalCode: String
  country: String
  cif: String
}

type UserPrice @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  userId: ID!
  productId: ID!
  specialPrice: Float!
}

type Order @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  id: ID!
  userId: String!
  customerEmail: String!
  customerName: String
  paymentMethod: String
  orderDate: String!
  status: String!
  totalAmount: Float!
  items: [OrderItem!]!
  shippingAddress: Address
  billingAddress: Address
}

type OrderConnection @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  items: [Order!]!
  nextToken: String
}

type OrderItem @aws_cognito_user_pools {
  productId: ID!
  variantId: ID!
  quantity: Int!
  priceAtPurchase: Float!
  name: String
  image: String
}
